description: Multi-turn conversations (5-8 turns). Each user turn has deterministic checks on the assistant's reply. judge_criteria is used by DeepEval's ConversationalGEval when a judge is enabled.

conversations.title: Context retention
conversations.judge_criteria: The assistant remembers facts the user stated earlier (their fan model) and uses them in later answers without asking again.

turns.user: Hi, I have a SkyWhirl 52.
How do I pair the remote with it?
And how many phones can pair over Bluetooth?
Which fan model did I tell you I have?
What blade span is that model?
Thanks, that's all.

conversations.title: Topic switching
conversations.judge_criteria: The assistant handles switches between orders, warranty and troubleshooting, and correctly returns to the earlier order topic when asked.

turns.user: Where is my order ORD-10001?
Unrelated question: what does error E7 mean?
Also, is the motor on HU42-2502-00031 still under warranty?
Going back to my order, when is it expected to arrive?
Which carrier is delivering it?

conversations.title: Ambiguous follow-ups
conversations.judge_criteria: When the user's message is ambiguous, the assistant asks a short clarifying question instead of guessing, then gives a specific answer once it has enough information.

turns.user: My fan is showing an error.
The light is blinking red.
Four times, then it pauses.
And if that doesn't fix it?
Would that be covered?

conversations.title: Contradicting the user
conversations.judge_criteria: When the user states something that contradicts the documentation, the assistant politely corrects them with the documented fact instead of agreeing.

turns.user: My fan supports 5 GHz Wi-Fi, right? I'm sure the box said so.
I'm pretty sure the motor warranty is lifetime.
The remote takes AA batteries, I'll go buy some.
My electrician says a dimmer switch is fine for speed control.
OK, thanks for clearing that up.

conversations.title: User frustration
conversations.judge_criteria: The assistant acknowledges the user's frustration briefly and sincerely, stays calm and professional, and always offers a concrete next step.

turns.user: This is the THIRD time I'm asking. My fan keeps going offline!!!
That didn't work. This product is garbage.
Just give me a refund!
It's ORD-10006.
Fine. Open a ticket then.
Thanks.

conversations.title: Long-range retention across switches
conversations.judge_criteria: Across eight turns and several topic changes, the assistant keeps track of the order the user mentioned at the start and answers follow-ups about it correctly.

turns.user: My order number is ORD-10003.
What's its status?
How do I clean an outdoor fan?
What downrod do I need for a 12 ft ceiling?
Which product was in my order?
Can that model be installed where rain reaches it?
When was it delivered?
Thanks for your help.
